method: For each curated farm group an overlay of the final geometry on the clean Warren plate (cw0353500 registered to the cw0325000a frame) was drawn and examined by eye at 3x. Faults found and fixed during the audit: almshouse points picked up contour marks (symbol list redone); Slyder west symbol missing (added); Leister house and barn symbols swapped (house is the east symbol); Bushman pair 40-60 m out in the global model (added as control); several hand-read symbol positions off the symbols (re-read from the blob detector).
